role: Generated grayscale botanical albedo, not a reference photograph
processing: Three quadrants are packed with transparent padding and petiole anchoring. Fourth quadrant is replaced by an opaque white material swatch. Palette PNG is converted to exact lossless WebP; decoded RGBA equality is enforced before GLB writing.
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: PBR diffuse/albedo foliage texture atlas for an original museum-quality Singapore rainforest / HDB-estate 3D miniature. Make ONE square 2-by-2 atlas, genuinely transparent alpha background. No text, no borders, no numbers. Each quadrant has 24-pixel padding and a separate leafy BRANCH CLUSTER whose stem attaches exactly at bottom centre and grows upward. Top-left: an irregular tropical rainforest broadleaf branch spray, with many small ovate waxy leaves on naturally crooked twig forks; not a fern. Top-right: Samanea saman rain-tree branch CLUSTER, many small bipinnate compound leaves, each compound leaf with several pinnae pairs and tiny asymmetric oval leaflets; the cluster must represent a leafy branch, not one enormous compound leaf. Bottom-left: Pterocarpus indicus angsana branch CLUSTER with many hanging pinnate compound leaves, each with 7–11 ovate leaflets. Bottom-right must be perfectly plain opaque white (reserved material swatch). Botanical realism, high-detail true small leaf silhouettes and organic twig growth, uneven overlapping layers, natural gaps distributed THROUGHOUT each cluster, irregular perimeter. Absolutely no circular rings, wreaths, central donut holes, regular radial fans, mirror symmetry, flat cut-paper silhouettes, geometric leaf shapes, cartoon outlines, clouds or blobs. Render as neutral GRAYSCALE realistic albedo, leaf values from medium gray to near white with small reflectance variations and fine veins; no green or other colour (the 3D renderer supplies Technical Plate colours). Fully diffuse flat illumination: no directional highlights, no baked cast shadows, no gradient backdrop, no ground, no pots, no entire trees. Perspective nearly orthographic from slightly above, exposing three-dimensional twisting leaves and twig attachments. Make leaf clusters broad and full enough for a realistic dense tropical canopy but with small gaps, crisp natural alpha edges.
